ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, in $\triangle ABC$, points $D$ and $E$ are on $AB$ and $AC$ respectively. If $\frac{AD}{AB}=\frac{AE}{AC}=\frac{1}{3}$, and the area of $\triangle ADE$ is 9, what is the area of quadrilateral $BCED$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since $\because \frac{AD}{AB}=\frac{AE}{AC}=\frac{1}{3}$ and $\angle A=\angle A$,\\
$\therefore \triangle ADE \sim \triangle ABC$ with a similarity ratio of $k=\frac{1}{3}$,\\
$\therefore S_{\triangle ADE} : S_{\triangle ABC} = 1 : 9$,\\
$\because S_{\triangle ADE} = 9$,\\
$\therefore S_{\triangle ABC} = 81$,\\
$\therefore$ the area of the quadrilateral $BCED$ is $S_{\triangle ABC} - S_{\triangle ADE} = 81 - 9 = \boxed{72}$.
